# S143 — Spec check follow-ups: answers survive a restart, main moving mid-check, sitting freeze, dropped Owner needed, shape retry, state dir cleanup

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Later notes from the S116 relay (2026-10-26). (1) Owner answers can be lost from the run brief after a daemon restart or a spec change: decisions live in daemon memory until a run starts; the main checkout keeps the paragraph, so a re-check says ready. (2) The spec check false-fails if the main checkout changes during the check. (3) The sitting can freeze while an answer waits on specMu. (4) The spec-check 'Owner needed' text is dropped. (5) A spec-check shape error has no retry. (6) ~/.local/state/ork/spec-checks dirs are never cleaned up. (7) wave start --json omits held items when the wave starts. (8) At 80x24 the held layout wraps and pushes overlap warnings to '+4 more'. (9) The sitting heading and the question title both use the bold Heading style. (10) The CLI sends Adj:true for keyed questions while the TUI uses reg.Adj. (11) When slicer s392 lands, replace SpecCheckRowID and rule u11 with slicer's role, and revert matrix row r16 with the code. The durable readiness record is slicer s400 (see S142).
